verdict.rationale: E2B documents that agent code and tools run in an isolated Firecracker microVM in the cloud, 'instead of your machine' or server. Host-side secrets and credentials are therefore structurally out of reach of the code the agent runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of credential/secret isolation or secret-handling guarantees (e.g., keeping injected env vars or API keys away from sandboxed code), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can give an agent a sandbox where host secrets and credentials are unreachable by the code it runs

citations.quote: your agent's code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of your server
the agent's built-in tools all execute inside an isolated sandbox instead of your machine
run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud
